method: Verified actual bytes of all 193 assigned deployment, tooling, workflow and corresponding test files against full8 and the complete full7 semantic baseline. Fully reread the sole changed in-scope document and reviewed current caller impact of the four separately audited WEB changes on workspace commit and exact-revision media download contracts. Rechecked real preflight/build validation and retained assertions, original failed-matrix evidence, diagnostic traces and final affected-case results. The 192 unchanged files reuse the complete semantic baseline with actual SHA and current dependency review; this is not a claim of newly rereading all unchanged bodies. No tests were executed during this audit.

baseline.coverage: Identical complete 146-file deployment and 47-file tooling/workflow/test assigned scope; no additions, removals or exclusions.

focusedCurrentConsumerReview: tests/tooling/release-preflight.test.ts real preflight and failure assertions
semanticReview: New Git lesson correctly identifies the actual first-interactable-render passive-effect cleanup race. The original Linux matrix failure and controlled single-click trace are retained; no timing-only flake dismissal or arbitrary sleep/retry is substituted for ownership correction.

New media lesson correctly identifies two analogous source-lifecycle failures independently reproduced on Windows: the new request aborted on project replacement and inline publication cleared after first click. These are additional probes, not extra failed full-matrix assertions.

Both production changes move only source/visibility lifecycle invalidation to layout timing. Exact status/diff/status preview, explicit confirmation, visible/enabled/current epoch checks and unknown-operation recovery remain; the independent WEB audit owns full frontend semantics and test review.

The existing Python Git commit contract still requires exact HEAD, HEAD revision and index revision, validates explicit author/message, checks ownership and in-progress operations, holds index and prepared reference locks, and uses expected-old publication. The frontend change introduces no new action or relaxed backend request.

Media loading retains typed not_found fallback, thread/item/source identity checks, bounded MIME/base64/bytes and object URL ownership. The Python workspace download still checks exact expectedRevision against actual bytes and descriptor-safe read. No deployed path, source scope or serialized contract changed.

All provider/profile budgets, toolchain cache binding, native process cleanup, HTTPS, transaction/recovery and deployment publication code remains byte-identical to the full7 complete review. The lesson-only in-scope edit cannot introduce a new runtime caller or privilege change.

Preflight still binds committed source, authorization, actual push/PR plans, tools and artifact evidence, then rechecks source and authorization. Its artifact tamper, failed rebuild record clearing and changed-source refusals remain present. No further timeout, concurrency, selection or platform-skip changes occurred.

The document requires exact final-state combined affected validation because Git-related components can reach shared media. The final eight-module set was rerun after all four WEB source/test edits and did not substitute an unrelated modal-only fixture.

evidenceReview.review: Rehashed declared original matrix, diagnostic, source and final targeted artifacts; parsed both final raw Vitest reports and independently matched all 148 names/statuses. Failed aggregate JavaScript groups omit cases, so raw Vitest remains authority. Original matrix3 stays failed/nonpublishable; the repaired source has not inherited a complete matrix pass. No separate Linux media-only 68-case execution is claimed.

limitations: No full suite, new targeted suite, provider/MCP call, hosted CI, service operation, commit or deployment was performed during this audit.
The complete prior semantic baseline is reused only where actual current SHA matches; unchanged bodies are not represented as freshly reread.
The four WEB edits are independently audited in the WEB scope; focused consumer review here does not replace that audit.
Offline tooling fixtures validate orchestration and refusal contracts; real candidate builds and a newly authorized complete matrix remain separate requirements.
Five delegated root fixtures and three Go entry/lock files remain in the parent reviewer scope; this report claims exactly its assigned 193 files.
A clean domain review is not aggregate clean authorization or release approval. The original failed matrices remain retained.
